Vendored schema resources retain their upstream licenses.

CycloneDX schema resources are from the OWASP CycloneDX specification project.
Copyright OWASP Foundation. Distributed under Apache License 2.0.
Source https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/tree/1.7.2/schema

SPDX generated JSON schema and JSON-LD context resources are from the SPDX
specification project. Generated artifacts are distributed under Apache License
2.0; the specification text is separately licensed under CC BY 3.0.
Source https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.0.1/

SOURCES.json records exact source locations and SHA-256 digests. The copied
schema/context resource bytes are unchanged. SymBiote validation and projection
code is separate from these third-party schema resources.
